description: Public_charging_infrastructure_monta is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Monta. The AFIR endpoint exposes publicly accessible static and dynamic data from Monta charge points, as required by Article 20 of the AFIR regulation. This includes metadata like location, connector types, power levels, status, availability, and ad hoc pricing. The goal is to promote transparency, accessibility, and interoperability across the EU’s alternative fuels infrastructure. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in JSON. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are RTTI. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
